title: Northbeam TechWorks Diagnosis: What Is Charged and What Is Not Carried Out
content:
The service's diagnostic charge is billed for finding a fault on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job, and where the customer goes ahead with the repair the charge is credited against it in full.

### A diagnosis that finds no fault

A diagnosis that finds no fault is still billed the diagnostic charge, because the time was spent.

### A diagnosis that finds the retailer's own error

Where the diagnosis finds the fault was the retailer's own installation error nothing is billed.

### A diagnosis that finds the site or the customer's own setup at fault

A diagnosis that finds the site was not ready, or that the customer's own setup caused the trouble, is billed the diagnostic charge and the crew attendance charge, and no labour is billed for work not carried out.

### Work the service does not include

Work the service does not include, such as new electrical circuits or water and waste connections where the service excludes them, is not carried out at all, and the customer is told to engage a licensed trade.

### A remote diagnosis that settles the matter

Where a remote diagnosis is included and settles the matter without a visit, nothing is billed.

### The five findings side by side

| What the diagnosis found | Diagnostic charge | Crew attendance charge | Labour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A fault, and the customer goes ahead with the repair | billed, then credited against the repair in full | — | — |
| No fault at all | billed | — | — |
| The retailer's own installation error | nothing is billed | nothing is billed | nothing is billed |
| The site was not ready | billed | billed | none for work not carried out |
| The customer's own setup caused the trouble | billed | billed | none for work not carried out |

Where a remote diagnosis is included under the service and settles the matter without a visit, nothing is billed at all.

The per-service figures this standard reads — the diagnostic charge, whether it is credited against the repair, whether new electrical work or water and waste connections are part of the service, whether a remote diagnosis is included, and the most the retailer will meet for damage caused during the work — are carried in the diagnostic, crew and settlement schedules for the six TechWorks services.
